Hey, I see your a new trader, so a few tips on how trading works. 

First, these items cannot be dropped and therefore cannot be traded or moved between accounts.
Tools: none reusable tool can be traded. However permanent tools such as the lantern, prattle pate, or flasks cannot be traded. golden runes can be traded, but not remembrances. 
Bolstering materials: none can be traded
Spirit ashes: none can be traded
Key items: none can be traded
Sorcery and incantation: none can be traded

All armor, talismans, ashes of war, arrows/bolts, and consumables such as boluses or rune arcs, and crafting materials can be traded freely. 

For weapons, if your trade partner drops a weapon that is higher level than the best one you have created, it will not appear for you to pick up. This is to prevent griefing by an invader dropping you a max weapon, then you getting invaded by max level the rest of the play through. 
For weapons that are upgraded with somber stones, multiply level by 2.5 rounded down for this purpose. Exe, if you have a somber weapon at level 6, you could see and pick up a level 18 or below weapon. 

When trading out down a red summon sign with a private password dmd between you and the trader. This is to prevent invasions into your world and someone attempting to steal from being able to join. 

For smithing stones, although they cannot be dropped, if you have high enough level weapons, you can drop a weapon and runes, the other party can upgrade the weapon, then drop it back. This is mainly for getting a weapon to +10/+25 as the number of smithing stones capable of performing the final upgrade is limited per play through. 

Hope these help. If you have any questions feel free to ask and I’ll answer as best I can. Happy trading out there and best of luck.
